nodes.label: Offline planner POLYLINE sampling
nodes.summary: The system keeps clusters of very short same-type path segments as continuous POLYLINE samples instead of repeatedly accelerating and decelerating each tiny segment.

nodes.label: UART nonblocking cut event
nodes.summary: UART treats cut as a nonblocking event so the RSI path does not wait for cut ACK or DONE, because cut lift, wait, and retract are pre-expanded offline.

nodes.label: export_npz is the central writer
nodes.location: 包定位 / 核心模块, approx lines 5-12
nodes.summary: All formal print, test print, and preview-loadable system NPZ files must be written through path_processing_core.npz_exporter.export_npz().

nodes.label: Short segment POLYLINE rule
nodes.location: 拟合与短线段采样, approx lines 55-58
nodes.summary: Three or more consecutive too-short print segments are merged into one POLYLINE sampling curve while preserving endpoint order and total delta_e.

nodes.label: Central CUT expansion
nodes.summary: A semantic CUT command is expanded by the exporter into a cut event, Z lift with matching E increase, remaining wait at height, and equal safety retract.

nodes.label: GCode adapter to core exporter
nodes.location: 当前定位 / 事件映射, approx lines 5-91
nodes.summary: gcode_planner parses GCode into shared command objects and delegates final system NPZ writing and CUT expansion to path_processing_core.export_npz().

nodes.label: GCode CLI cut parameters
nodes.summary: The GCode CLI exposes cut_lift_mm and cut_wait_s as user parameters with defaults of 20.0 mm and 15.0 s.

nodes.label: External NPZ input path
nodes.location: 包定位 / 导出流程, approx lines 5-75
nodes.summary: external_npz_preprocessor converts source NPZ layer and material paths into shared commands, then calls export_npz for the system NPZ.

nodes.label: External NPZ shared parameters
nodes.location: Shared Parameters / Shared Head Offsets, approx lines 61-98
nodes.summary: External NPZ conversion forwards dt, cut_lift_mm, cut_wait_s, tool offsets, and resin Z compensation directly to the shared exporter.

nodes.label: Source NPZ emits semantic CUT only
nodes.summary: For fiber paths, the source NPZ converter inserts only a semantic CUT command and leaves final cut event, lift, wait, and retract generation to export_npz().

nodes.label: UI formal export routing
nodes.location: 5.4 正式打印输入适配, approx lines 304-316
nodes.summary: The formal print UI routes GCode and source NPZ inputs to their adapters, collects parameters and offsets, and passes cut_lift_mm and cut_wait_s to the shared exporter.
